intent: A titled group of items inside a CommandList, hidden while none of its items matches the search.
typical_uses: Items of one kind under one heading

dont_use_when.situation: A group of rows in a menu anchored to a trigger

invariants.text: `heading` renders in its own div, hidden from assistive technology, and names the inner `role="group"` element that holds the items through `aria-labelledby`; the outer div, which receives the caller's props and `className`, carries `role="presentation"`.

While the search text is not empty the group carries the `hidden` attribute when none of its items matches, unless `forceMount` is true or the root's `shouldFilter` is false; `forceMount` on the group also keeps every item inside it rendered.

anti_patterns.dont: Put a heading element as the group's first child
anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass the heading text as `heading`, which names the group and is styled by command.module.css

children.because: `React.ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

heading.states: heading is the group's visible title and accessible name
heading.because: `React.ReactNode` is a union, and the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

unexposed_parts.part: The library's group heading and group items divs
unexposed_parts.reason: Fixed markup inside the group: the heading div (reached only by command.module.css's `[cmdk-group-heading]` selector) and the `role="group"` div holding the items.

bad.title: A heading passed as a child
bad.why: The child renders as one more piece of content inside the `role="group"` element instead of naming it; without `heading` the group has no accessible name and command.module.css's heading style does not apply.

children.description: TS: ReactNode. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. children is the group's items. `React.ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

heading.description: TS: ReactNode. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. heading is the group's visible title and accessible name. `React.ReactNode` is a union, and the compiler emits one JSON type per property.
